OpenClaw 2026.10.2

Highlights

  • Updates from 2026.10.1: the first upgrade from stable 2026.10.1 now completes cleanly, successful in-place updates no longer end in errors, and Windows, cloned-filesystem, and private-Node update paths finish instead of stalling or rolling back. (#168849, #169031, #165233, #166530, #168968, #164677, #165257) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jarvisnextgeneration20-lang, and @MrJanvar.
  • Doctor and update recovery: Doctor no longer stops on residual legacy imports, stale Gateway locks, slow state inspection, memory reindex locks, or allowlists for removed channel accounts, and stale-receipt sessions keep their current data. (#166397, #165355, #165417, #168161, #166517, #167651, #165775) Thanks @coolcoolwcr, @obviyus, @Tosko4, @noelff, @oshunter, @donquiche61, and @RomneyDa.
  • Provider-native compaction: OpenAI and Anthropic API-key routes now default to provider-native compaction, and compaction recovers when the primary auth profile is cooling down. (#168164, #166459) Thanks @obviyus and @hawkit.
  • Secret redaction: credentials that cross a chunk boundary in long tool output are now masked, and redaction of large text no longer stalls or overflows the stack while running several times faster. (#161480, #166701, #167943) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
  • Prompt-cache stability: Anthropic conversation checkpoints, enriched user prompts, tool results, and inter-session provenance stay byte-identical across follow-ups, replays, Gateway restarts, and subagent completions, so cached prefixes keep hitting. (#168042, #167938, #168392, #167898, #169130, #169238) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Gateway responsiveness: Control UI reconnects, model changes with large plugins, dashboard title work, and catalog loading no longer freeze the Gateway or hang new sessions. (#167374, #161267, #162689, #166089, #166376) Thanks @jalehman, @obviyus, @ericcaiwx-star, @cursoragent, @dimonnld, and @dprev.

Changes

  • Defaulted OpenAI and Anthropic API-key routes to provider-native compaction. (#168164) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Reported finalized update successes and suppressed channels as warnings instead of failures. (#169037)
  • Stopped live npm dist-tag drift from failing already-validated release candidates. (#168836) Thanks @RomneyDa.

Fixes

  • Fixed credential leaks across redaction chunk boundaries and redaction stalls on large tool output. (#161480) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
  • Fixed replies lost while an agent finishes starting, streamed Telegram replies vanishing when the replacement message never lands, and Telegram treating local owner rejection as ambiguous delivery. (#168826, #164649, #167470) Thanks @xiaozishan, @jayzhou2309, @obviyus, @jmar5439, and @mgr-nick.
  • Fixed Claude CLI sessions showing runtime prompts as user messages, routed CLI prompts appearing on the owner's side of history, lost replies after long streamed turns, and post-turn compaction failing without an Anthropic API key. (#166080, #163521, #153545, #162066) Thanks @Marvinthebored, @Peetiegonzalez, @RomneyDa, @rogeriochaves, @zhangguiping-xydt, @obviyus, @methylester, @llmsommelier, and @ajmtrz.
  • Fixed subagent and ACP answers being truncated, superseded child answers delivered by late receipts, and requester turns stopping when completion delivery expires. (#165800, #162843, #166139, #164282) Thanks @yetval, @holgergruenhagen, @zyz619963502zyz, @Yun-0000, @michaeljgood71, @Oldrich333, and @obviyus.
  • Fixed runs aborted as stalled after completed async tools or while waiting on plugin approval, context-engine advancement lost after steering, and the tool loop refilling from the wrong context window. (#166997, #161821, #168394, #166120) Thanks @SunnyShu0925, @hannesrudolph, @fransqaas, @obviyus, @robertoronderosjr, @ruel225, and @igs-rogenlo.
  • Fixed OpenAI turns failing on regex-lookaround tool schemas, ChatGPT websocket expiry and 16 MiB SSE limits, strict chat templates after runtime notices, and Code Mode calls with repeated tool-call IDs. (#166999, #167063, #166853, #167309, #165210) Thanks @scs0209, @cursoragent, @obviyus, @adamjgmiller, @Jackten, @jlapenna, and @RomneyDa.
  • Fixed Codex sessions stopping after thread unloads, leaked app-server clients after model discovery timeouts, provider failures shown as a silent stop, and max thinking dropping on cron and hook turns. (#166693, #168365, #165488, #165444) Thanks @jalehman, @Oldrich333, and @obviyus.
  • Fixed sessions failing every turn after a truncated image, the agent disowning earlier image answers, and memory_search snake_case arguments being rejected through tool_call. (#166564, #166165, #158632) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @mirasrael, @nogikeyaksh, @masatohoshino, and @obviyus.
  • Fixed scheduled cron runs losing the Gateway plugin registry, manual cron runs losing tool access, runs rejected after catalog publication, and preflight compaction skipped for completion turns. (#166991, #168037, #168410, #163117) Thanks @67-luck, @lucianosmori, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @SunnyShu0925, and @AXEG0.
  • Fixed the Control UI hold-to-dictate button stopping on release, typed /stop letting queued turns restart the agent, repeated browser replies after background work, and pending Home creation notices piling up. (#166843, #167860, #166362, #168239) Thanks @alfredjbclaw, @obviyus, @masatohoshino, and @shakkernerd.
  • Fixed update failures from absolute avatar paths, refused finalize steps leaving the Gateway stopped, and the SQLite worker launch error hidden behind a TypeError. (#164638, #166548, #165373) Thanks @nitinjwadhawan and @Shirleyyyhk.
  • Fixed worker capacity leaks after forced descendant cleanup and browser tab eviction at the managed tab cap. (#168746, #166666) Thanks @aniruddhaadak80, @ruel225, and @obviyus.
  • Fixed Feishu replaying obsolete streaming previews, Bedrock custom provider routes using the wrong region, the egress proxy CA rejected by strict TLS clients, and quoted Windows shell arguments in the node host. (#166610, #164406, #165818, #158160) Thanks @rudycelekli, @Takhoffman, @Ayushdevo, @obviyus, @kai-ocean-kurt, @vortexopenclaw, @RyanSandoval, @Dimitri-lcht, and @igs-rogenlo.
  • Fixed macOS crashes: the Swift compiler crash in the sidebar picker, Rosetta segfaults, Intel worker startup, and managed llama.cpp setup on macOS below 13.3. (#165573, #165088, #161876, #163358) Thanks @shakkernerd, @NovaUnboundAi, @VACInc, and @xXG0DLessXx.
  • Logged update config fallback diagnostics as warnings and unblocked production lint suppression checks. (#165539, #166841) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.

OpenClaw 2026.10.1

Highlights

  • Sessions and memory: preserved usage across registry changes, delivered worker attachments from remote workspaces, prevented queued cancellations and transcript aliases from stalling active turns, kept continuation signatures aligned, and migrated embedding caches in bounded batches with oversized-row reporting. (#164217, #164219, #163708, #164230, #164251, #164289, #164287, #164303) Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
  • Replies and media: restored inline playback for local videos, replaced rejected media links with useful errors, kept Telegram progress updates free of preview cards, and fixed speech-only replies when reasoning is enabled. (#164137, #163727, #164285, #164256) Thanks @ivan-magda, @obviyus, and @Twilight-Networks.
  • Updates and Doctor: improved serving-verdict recovery guidance, kept repairs working with read-only managed config, removed repeated config, backup, metadata, and pnpm-root probes, reported successful cleanup as progress without corrupting JSON output, and treated a still-starting Gateway as a warning. (#164193, #161924, #164235, #162259, #164182, #164186, #164183, #164184, #163477, #164261, #162236, #164312) Thanks @DonnieFi, @JD8855122, @Patrick-Erichsen, @waynegault, and @RomneyDa.
  • Windows workspaces and browser startup: fixed empty and nested Windows worktree creation, improved Linux Chromium discovery, and automatically started Playwright Chromium on ARM64. (#164202, #164249, #163510, #163281) Thanks @ly85206559, @jesse-merhi, and @obviyus.
  • Cloud workers and Crabbox: surfaced the real cloud-worker failure, enforced Linux leases, overlapped worker-bundle downloads with bootstrap, removed unrelated warm-image cleanup waits, and prevented slow reads or unsupported backends from stranding workers. (#164129, #164187, #164128, #164231)
  • Plugins, Codex, and MCP: preserved Bun package-import capture, reduced prerelease metadata requests, kept expired remote-exec approvals from poisoning auth profiles, restored node policy hooks, synchronized MCP forms/files/context, and routed background skill reviews through Workshop proposals. (#164223, #164185, #164237, #164270, #164277, #164292)
  • Safer recovery and responsive chats: recovered interrupted database workers and Doctor migrations, kept background CLI replies from hanging, and preserved automatic chat following as new content arrives. (#163258, #165854, #167091) Thanks @goutamadwant, @hawkit, @RomneyDa, @Olli0103, @ericcurtin, @obviyus, @adele-with-a-b, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @vincentkoc.

Changes

  • Added Claude Haiku 5.5 support. (#166706) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Kept Code Mode store/load values available across cells, replies, and Gateway restarts. (#164086)
  • Added Workboard sidebar navigation and personal board pinning. (#164604)
  • Let MCP Apps call their tools while their views remain open, with inline message confirmations and synchronized forms, files, and context. (#164496, #164493, #164277)
  • Added inline YouTube playback to Control UI chats. (#164576)
  • Added native macOS sidebar identity details and plugin session catalogs, and used bundled Bun in the Linux companion. (#164591, #164436, #164401)
  • Adopted sealed immutable installation generations with activation and recovery support. (#163799, #164306)
  • Let the selected memory plugin own the pre-compaction memory flush. (#162177) Thanks @jalehman.
  • Let every loaded plugin, including local paths and linked installs, use its own isolated state and ingress queues without changing trust requirements for privileged capabilities. (#165063)
  • Added cloud-worker support for enterprise repositories. (#160108) Thanks @galiniliev.
  • Added RPC response-size and main-thread heap diagnostics, with exclusive-handler sampling to avoid misleading measurements. (#164335, #164418)
  • Migrated existing agents to local Claws. (#162329) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Reduced Sessions-board and state-path overhead by serving prepared facts, reusing card payloads per store revision, moving lifecycle mutations off the main thread, and retaining canonical state handles. (#164218, #164301, #163815, #164110) Thanks @RomneyDa.

Fixes

  • Agents and subagents: memory-saving turns no longer regain unrelated execution tools, finished subagent results are delivered even while a grandchild's delivery is still pending, follow-up messages no longer cut off returning subagent results, completed answers survive a reasoning-only tail, and sessions on small context windows recover after auto-compaction. (#166650; fixes #166644, #165987; fixes #138632, #168068; fixes #162761, #167567; fixes #167543, #167900) Thanks @jlapenna, @Oldrich333, @obviyus, @LifeViwer, @stackingrockss, @goutamadwant, @hannesrudolph, and @RomneyDa.
  • Updates and Doctor: prepared activations settle when the live package already serves the candidate, rollback skips the maintenance drain when the Gateway is already stopped, dead legacy child-lineage leases no longer block every later update, triage stops prescribing repeated refused updates while activation recovery is pending, update repair leaves live current handoff owners alone, and Doctor maintenance no longer exhausts systemd service-inspection deadlines. (#167648, #167649; fixes #165266, #168043; fixes #168000, #167782, #168197, #168069; fixes #168031) Thanks @hannnnn-l, @farisoftfry, @Tosko4, and @RomneyDa.
  • Gateway startup with installed plugins: valid startups no longer capture and discard plugin Doctor modules on every config read, Windows plugin captures use the fast pinned-descriptor copy again so Gateways with large plugins start without multi-minute stalls, catalog updates no longer recapture plugins after startup, model changes no longer freeze the Gateway with large plugins, and Windows launchers keep working after pnpm updates. (#168017, #167544, #161267, #167905; fixes #167835) Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @SMF12138, and @jjjhenriksen.
  • Codex, ChatGPT, and local models: Codex replies no longer lose their last token when a provider stream drops the final delta, rejected cached ChatGPT tool continuations recover without rerunning completed tools, oversized proxy requests report context errors instead of one-token replies, resumed Claude sessions refresh their system context, Ollama tool calls work with Tool Search enabled, trailing Gemma 4 tool-call text is recovered, and managed llama.cpp memory indexing no longer runs out of memory on small hosts. (#168055, #167878; fixes #161254, #167817; fixes #167799, #167933, #167886; fixes #104868, #168020) Thanks @jacobtomlinson, @amittell, @yu-xin-c, @robburke, @jlapenna, @frankhli843, and @RomneyDa.
  • Channels, state, and memory: Telegram keeps pending questions when /verbose, /think, or other settings commands arrive, Gateways on Bun no longer report false state-ownership loss, separate Docker CLI containers and recreated Docker owners keep Gateway state ownership, and memory-wiki status no longer recompiles an unchanged externally refreshed vault. (#168004, #167669, #164236; fixes #163961, #164546; fixes #155644, #167929; fixes #167914) Thanks @obviyus, @JakeMalis, @Alex-vonAllmen, and @etzelm.
  • Install and terminals: global npm installs keep native packages to the current platform, and local browser terminals advertise RGB colors on headless hosts. (#165997; fixes #165602, #164325; fixes #164323) Thanks @TommyFive, @ooiuuii, and @obviyus.
  • Security and privacy: rejected NUL execution arguments before startup, failed closed on unresolved peer credentials, prevented stale Codex sessions and foreign live owners from mutating successor workspaces, and kept private runtime context out of replies and saved conversations. (#164770, #165021, #164197, #164203, #163471, #164561) Thanks @shakkernerd, @eleqtrizit, @galiniliev, @KirDE, @RomneyDa, @consoleaf, and @JacquesLFR8.
  • Reply delivery: retained completed answers instead of replacing them with blocker summaries or generic follow-up warnings, showed authoritative tool outcomes and native tool failures, and prevented silent-reply markers from leaking into previews. (#164896, #164774, #163545, #164116, #164259, #160582) Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @joshavant, @ooiuuii, @jayzhou2309, and @imabotone-ui.
  • Telegram and Discord: delivered later messages without deferred-ingress stalls, kept Telegram photo albums together and ordered under load, restored channel-routed handoff sends, and kept long Discord model IDs selectable. (#159265, #164549, #163926, #163863, #165137, #164311) Thanks @aatreya, @mbelinky, @ooiuuii, and @obviyus.
  • Other channels and hooks: resolved workspace-qualified Slack users, migrated unscoped WhatsApp credentials through Doctor, stopped repeated Gmail error alerts on redelivery, and treated zero channel media limits as unlimited rather than blocking every attachment. (#160619, #163203, #164206, #163701) Thanks @LinzeShi, @obviyus, @jayzhou2309, @TrevorDGreen33, and @sxh313.
  • Models and providers: fixed malformed Kimi K3 execution calls, preserved shared Codex clients after interruption, refreshed models from standalone Anthropic profiles, corrected Ollama Cloud thinking controls, restored Baseten setup defaults, and honored longer video-generation timeouts. (#165022, #165487, #156493, #162300, #155640, #162204, #164389, #164381) Thanks @serg0x, @Ram-G, and @RomneyDa.
  • Preserved exact provider identity in model lookups and refreshed Vertex access tokens through Google Auth instead of reusing stale non-file ADC tokens. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Preserved admitted chat, cron, and Gateway turns during model-catalog updates, including quota recovery before the first model response. (#167492) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Clarified that protected credentials support HTTPS proxy substitution, not SSH/sudo passwords or subprocess stdin, and explained the separate operator-controlled environment-entry path. (#167976) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Updates: recovered archives without leaving Gateways stopped, settled replaced lease-database identities and moved package receipts, kept non-root launcher ownership and relinked launchers from stranding upgrades, preserved checkout plugin skills and historical webhook migrations during plugin convergence, and completed October beta updater compatibility. (#165854, #164849, #166394, #164636, #164438, #165882, #165855, #165303) Thanks @RomneyDa, @Olli0103, @szef-svg, @izrl613, @neilofneils404, @hrp6vv9mwr-glitch, and @shakkernerd.
  • Update recovery: kept completed recovery history from blocking later updates, made archival failures warnings while preserving evidence, repaired verified publications and untouched preparations after missing handoff lease databases, and retained current service ownership and unfinished rollback checks. (#167302, #167330, #167358, #164997, #165238, #165607; fixes #164254, #164214) Thanks @shanselman, @RomneyDa, @Hensarj, and @NovaeonStudio.
  • Let published legacy updaters run Doctor subcommands without a newer update-run ID while preserving command custody and invalid-ID rejection. (#167833; fixes #167824) Thanks @GoDiao.
  • Doctor and service recovery: imported retained session receipts and legacy entry state before SQLite migration, supported Linux filesystems without birthtime, quarantined unusable deletion journals, drained databases and command-owned workers before exit, kept maintenance entry points usable under lease-liveness checks, and recovered updates blocked by stale deferred session-import receipts bound to a replaced database while preserving original evidence and recoverable history. (#164867, #165866, #164363, #164509, #164503, #164853, #164915, #164697, #167538; fixes #167428) Thanks @hshs38033-cmd, @SunnyShu0925, @609NFT, @jayzhou2309, @StevenKrebs, @rosmiroslav-create, @RomneyDa, and @bipolar84.
  • macOS and Windows services: restored stop, restart, and update on macOS Monterey when launchctl denies PID domains, recovered disabled Windows Gateway tasks, fenced native app service installs to their observed runtime, reconnected after trusted-certificate renewal, and stopped slow macOS Gateway startup after reboot from triggering repeated restarts while rechecking reused launchd PIDs after startup progress. (#163317, #164728, #164616, #164435, #158954; fixes #158936) Thanks @NovaUnboundAi, @xXG0DLessXx, @RomneyDa, @fuller-stack-dev, @joryirving, @MertBasar0, and @cjn119-ui.
  • Gateway and sessions: bounded New Session model-catalog waits, paused recovery while the crash-loop breaker is tripped, stopped restarts from looking like plugin removal, recovered unexpectedly exited database workers, kept later CLI bridge calls usable after their creating turn ends, and preserved concurrent first requests to a new agent. (#165989, #166238, #164975, #163258, #165428, #166003) Thanks @DonnieFi, @dprev, @goutamadwant, @hawkit, @nano-richtera, and @RomneyDa.
  • Storage and memory: removed large-store SQL-variable failures and rollback-journal lock failures, protected restore capacity, retained detached-maintenance database custody, released discarded transcript/output buffers and idle runtime state, reduced transcript-worker and background model-discovery memory, kept long leases from expiring early, and retained background memory synchronization and nightly dreaming across plugin reloads. (#164336, #164624, #164492, #164361, #164441, #164467, #164386, #166069, #167467, #167679, #167724) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @obviyus, @nkarkare, @triciah73, and @RomneyDa.
  • Workers and plugins: restored external-plugin hidden-chunk import closure, avoided slow native-prebuild loading, retained cooperative checkpoints under pressure, kept worktree leases alive during slow preparation, and fixed nested Windows session/workspace result publication. (#165669, #165301, #164537, #164521, #162033, #164331) Thanks @LiuwqGit, @JakeBotFleet, @goutamadwant, @exGeni, @cestercian, @RomneyDa, and @zhyx1996.
  • Worker deadlines: stopped expired worker tasks from leaving host callbacks queued across SQLite, plugin-state, cold-restoration, history, usage, and incognito operations, while preserving accepted writes and required cleanup settlement. (#167740) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Preserved archived session-import bindings after source retirement so old files cannot replay into replacement sessions. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Restored file-only ChatGPT import rollback without treating the import directory as a writable page. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Plugin installs and refreshes: restored Windows plugin loading from Node version-manager and Scoop paths with ancestor junctions, reused verified native-plugin captures instead of repeating capture work on each catalog refresh, and kept pinned source captures independent of later file changes and bound Doctor callbacks to their selected plugin generation during updates. (#167588, #166687; fixes #167579; related #165686) Thanks @JIRBOY, @matthematics1137, @martinderm, @swampgorilla, @obviyus, @jjjhenriksen, and @RomneyDa.
  • Model-catalog recovery: made worker failures visible in logs and health/status with their reason and affected-agent count, and restored catalog recovery after non-native preparation timeouts without requiring a restart. (#161740; fixes #161738) Thanks @matthematics1137, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
  • Control UI: kept the UI readable and available under arbitrary user IDs, recovered model setup after Gateway restarts, made sensitive config fields editable, respected IME confirmation keys, showed approval scopes, cleared stale saved-message banners after delivery, reduced startup downloads by loading device-only English copy with Devices views, preserved provider identity when selecting automation models, and kept progress images available after task cleanup for recovered and internally started runs. (#165880, #164602, #163487, #164560, #164534, #164486, #164735, #164574, #165275; fixes #164572) Thanks @RomneyDa, @Conan-Scott, @ericcurtin, @obviyus, @shakkernerd, and @ooiuuii.

OpenClaw 2026.9.9

Highlights

  • GPT-6.1 Sol support: update the managed Codex app-server and its embedded model catalog so native Codex sessions can discover and run GPT-6.1 Sol. (#161446, #163560) Thanks @IstiqlalBhat, @fuller-stack-dev, @vincentkoc, and @RomneyDa.
  • Safer updates: inspect live WAL ownership without unstable full-database copies and retain published 2026.9.8 updater compatibility. (#162268, #163998) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Responsive background work: reuse the prepared runtime for Skill Workshop reviews and rooted cron jobs so they no longer stall the Gateway. (#164049) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Windows session recovery: bind session creation to the physical SQLite store identity so junction-backed stores publish correctly. (#162033) Thanks @cestercian, @RomneyDa, and @zhyx1996.
  • Cross-platform reliability: prevent Node process-exit hangs, preserve node work during metadata updates, and restore native Windows workspace and sandbox startup. (#163788, #164087, #164202, #158303) Thanks @paulcam206 and @RomneyDa.

Changes

  • No intentional capability changes beyond enabling the already-advertised GPT-6.1 Sol model on the managed Codex runtime.

Fixes

  • Codex: ship the 0.160.0 managed app-server, synchronized protocol/catalog metadata, and a package-level regression that requires GPT-6.1 Sol in the bundled native catalog. (#161446, #163560) Thanks @IstiqlalBhat, @fuller-stack-dev, @vincentkoc, and @RomneyDa.
  • Update and Gateway availability: avoid unstable live-database copies during ownership admission, reuse prepared plugin/runtime facts for rooted work, preserve node work through metadata refreshes, and retain 2026.9.8 first-hop compatibility.
